answer: Approval requires signers drawn from at least three separate invitation subtrees with no shared inviter within five hops, so one farm branch can occupy only one slot in any approving panel no matter how many identities it registers. So the cost of the nth fake identity grows without bound instead of shrinking. Picture a ripple with one ticket, a lantern that separates tickets from strangers, and a bridge that tallies tickets by tree: buying more identities in one ripple changes nothing about the lantern or the bridge tally.
